ul.li: Bit swapping is allowed within each Byte for all memory technologies.
DDR5 x32 sub-channels can be swizzle within their x64 MC.
DDR5: Byte Swapping is allowed within each x32 channel.
LPDDR5: Byte swapping is allowed within a 16-bit channel.
LPDDR5: x16 sub-channels can be swizzled within their x64 MC.
When swapping channel DQ, the CA/CS signals must be swapped as well.
DDR5 x32 sub-channels can be swizzle within their x64 MC.
